title: Decision Nº 066/008/2004 CC.D of December 03, 2004
text:
KINGDOM OF CAMBODIA 
Nation Religion King 
 
The Constitutional Council 
 CASE 
Nº 088/011/2004 
Of November 11, 2004 
 Decision 
Nº 066/008/2004 CC.D 
Of December 03, 2004 
The Constitutional Council 
 
- Seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia of 1993; 
- Seen Preah Reach Kram Nº CS/RKM/0498/06 of April 8, 1998 on the 
Organization and the Functioning of the Constitutional Council; 
- Seen Preah Reach Kram Nº 02 NS/RKM/94 of July 20, 1994 on the 
Organization and the Functioning of the Council of Ministers; 
- Seen the letter Nº 303 AN of November 10, 2004 from Samdech HENG 
SAMRIN , Acting President of the National Assembly, requesting the 
Constitutional Council to review the constitutionality of the Law on the 
Establishment of Ministry of Labor and Vocational Training, letter received 
by the Secretariat General of the Constitutional Council on November 11, 
2004. 
 
Having heard the rapporteur, 
Having deliberated in compliance with the law, 
 
- Whereas the National Assembly and the Senate have duly implemented the 
procedures provided for in the Article 113N concerning the examination and 
the adoption of the law on the Establishment of Ministry of Labor and 
Vocational Training; 
- Whereas the request for reviewing the constitutionality of the Organic Law 
by the Acting President of the National Assembl y is in compliance with the 
constitution (sentence 1, Article 140N of the Constitution.); 
- Whereas the decision on the constitutionality of the Organic Law is within 
the competence of the Constitutional Council (sentence 2, Article 140N of 
the Con stitution); 
- Whereas the procedure of legislation and the adoption of this Organic Law 
has no provision contrary to the constitution; 
- Whereas the substance of the Articles 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 of the Law on the 
Establishment of Ministry of Labor and Vocational Training does not contain 
any point contradictory to the Constitution. 
 
Decides: 
 
 Article 1 – The Law on the Establishme nt of Ministry of Labor and 
 Vocational Training adopted by the National Assembly on 
 October 26, 2004 and entirely reviewed by the Senate on 
 November 05, 2004 is declared constitutiona l. 
 
 Article 2 : The decision made in the plenary session of the Constitutional 
 Council in Phnom Penh on December 03, 2004 shall be final 
 without recourse, shall have authority over all the instituted 
 powers as stipulated in the Constitution, and shall be published 
 in the “Journal Officiel”. 
 
 Phnom Penh , December 03, 2004 
 For the Constitutional Council 
 The President 
 Signed and Sealed 
 
 BIN CHHIN
summary: Decision Nº 066/008/2004 CC.D of December 03, 2004: Request of Samdech HENG SAMRIN , Acting President of the National Assembly, to the Constitutional Council for reviewing the constitutionality the Law on the he Establishment of Ministry of Labor and Vocational Training.
